extra_vocab.en: an extra item that you can add to a main product
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指主產品（無線喇叭）以外、可另外加購的物品，也就是攜帶盒。optional accessory 表示「選購配件」，客人可買可不買。

example.en: The carrying case is an optional accessory for this speaker.
example.zh: 攜帶盒是這款喇叭的選購配件。

example.en: The accessory kit comes with a cable and a stand.
example.zh: 配件組附有一條線材和一個支架。

example.en: Our store sells phone accessories at low prices.
example.zh: 我們的店以低價販售手機配件。

example.en: Many shops sell accessories to earn extra profit.
example.zh: 許多商店販售配件來賺取額外利潤。

examples.en: Customers often buy an accessory together with the main product.
examples.zh: 顧客常常把配件和主產品一起購買。

examples.en: Please find the list of available accessories attached to this email.
examples.zh: 附件是可購買的配件清單，請查收。

examples.en: We need to order more accessories before the holiday season starts.
examples.zh: 我們需要在假期旺季開始前訂購更多配件。

examples.en: This accessory is sold separately and is not included in the box.
examples.zh: 這個配件需另購，並未附在盒子裡。

examples.en: She wore a simple scarf as her only accessory.
examples.zh: 她只戴了一條簡單的圍巾當作飾品。

confusable.diff: 字形相近，但 accessible 是形容詞，意思是「容易取得或到達的」，不是「配件」。
component 是產品本身的組成零件；accessory 是可另外加上的附加物品。

example.en: All staff have access to the online system.
example.zh: 所有員工都能使用這個線上系統。

example.en: The office is easily accessible by train.
example.zh: 搭火車就能很容易到達這間辦公室。

example.en: We sell the speaker and its accessory parts.
example.zh: 我們販售這款喇叭及其附屬零件。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，意思是「接近、取得」
access + -ible（-able 的變體），可以被接近的，像 available、comfortable
accessible 去掉 le 加 -ility，變成名詞，像 able → ability

example.en: The charger is sold as an accessory for this laptop.
example.zh: 這個充電器是這款筆電的配件。

example.en: The accessory buildings are used to store tools and parts.
example.zh: 這些附屬建築是用來存放工具和零件的。

senses.en: an extra item that you can add to a main product

example.en: You can buy a protective cover as an accessory.
example.zh: 你可以另外購買保護套作為配件。

senses.en: something you wear to go with your clothes, such as a belt or a bag
senses.distinguish: 出現在服飾店或穿搭情境時，指皮帶、圍巾、包包等飾品。

example.en: The store sells bags, belts, and other fashion accessories.
example.zh: 這家店販售包包、皮帶和其他時尚飾品。

extra_vocab.en: not together with other things; as a different item
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，purchased separately 指攜帶袋不包含在目前的套裝內，客人要另外單獨購買。這是銷售與產品說明中很常見的說法，常和 sold separately 一起出現。

example.en: The batteries are sold separately from the main unit.
example.zh: 電池與主機是分開販售的。

example.en: Extra filters can be purchased separately online.
example.zh: 額外的濾網可以在網路上單獨購買。

example.en: The two orders will be shipped separately next week.
example.zh: 這兩筆訂單將在下週分開出貨。

example.en: Delivery costs are billed separately from the product price.
example.zh: 運費與商品價格是分開計費的。

examples.en: I will send the signed contract to you separately.
examples.zh: 我會另外把簽好的合約寄給您。

examples.en: Let's discuss the budget and the schedule separately.
examples.zh: 我們把預算和時程分開來討論吧。

examples.en: Please submit each travel receipt separately for faster approval.
examples.zh: 請把每張差旅收據分開提交，以便更快核准。

examples.en: Each department prepared its report separately this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季各部門各自獨立準備了報告。

confusable.diff: individually 強調「一個一個地」處理或對待每個人或物；separately 強調「與其他東西分開」，不一定逐一處理。
apart 表示彼此相距或分離的狀態（如 two meters apart）；separately 表示以獨立的方式處理或購買。

example.en: Please use a separate form for each request.
example.zh: 每項申請請使用獨立的表格。

example.en: Please separate the invoices by department.
example.zh: 請依部門將發票分開。

example.en: The separation of the two teams improved efficiency.
example.zh: 兩個團隊分開之後提升了效率。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；separate + -ly 變成副詞 separately，像 quickly、carefully
separate + -ion，把「分開」變成名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: to write down or save information so that you can use it later
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是動詞（重音在後面），record the requests 指把顧客提出的需求「登記下來」，以便之後討論是否推出配件。名詞 record（重音在前，/ˈrekərd/）則指「紀錄、檔案」，兩者發音不同要注意。

example.en: Please record the details of each complaint in the system.
example.zh: 請把每件客訴的細節記錄在系統裡。

example.en: We keep a record of every payment from our clients.
example.zh: 我們保留每一筆客戶付款的紀錄。

example.en: This was the highest monthly sales figure on record.
example.zh: 這是有紀錄以來最高的單月銷售數字。

example.en: The company reported record sales in the fourth quarter.
example.zh: 公司公布第四季創下紀錄的銷售額。

examples.en: Could you record the meeting so absent staff can watch it?
examples.zh: 你可以把會議錄下來，讓缺席的同事能觀看嗎？

examples.en: Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes.
examples.zh: 通話可能會被錄音，用於訓練與品質目的。

examples.en: The personnel office keeps an employee record for each worker.
examples.zh: 人事室為每位員工保存一份人事紀錄。

confusable.diff: register 是「登記、註冊」，常指正式向機構登記；record 是把資訊寫下或錄下來保存。
report 是向他人「報告、通報」；record 是把資訊「記下來」，不一定要告訴別人。

example.en: A recording of the webinar will be sent to everyone.
example.zh: 網路研討會的錄影會寄給每個人。

example.en: The assistant placed a recorder on the meeting table.
example.zh: 助理把一支錄音機放在會議桌上。

example.en: Please document every change you make to the file.
example.zh: 請用文件記錄你對檔案做的每項更動。

derived.link: record + -ing，把「錄」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting、building
record + -er，做事的人或機器，像 printer、worker

example.en: Please record the name of each caller in the log.
example.zh: 請把每位來電者的姓名記在登記簿上。

example.en: The clerk keeps a record of every payment we make.
example.zh: 店員保存我們每一筆付款的紀錄。

example.en: The firm reported record profits for the third quarter.
example.zh: 公司公布第三季創下紀錄的獲利。

senses.en: to write down information so that you can use it later

example.en: Staff must record every delivery in the system.
example.zh: 員工必須把每一次送貨登記在系統裡。

senses.en: to save sound or video so that people can play it later
senses.distinguish: 對象是會議、通話、節目等聲音或影像時，指錄音錄影。

example.en: We will record the webinar and send the link tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們會錄下這場網路研討會，並在明天寄出連結。

senses.en: the best result that has ever been reached
senses.distinguish: 常見 set a record、break a record，和一般的資料紀錄不同。

example.en: Online sales set a new record during the holiday week.
example.zh: 假期那一週的網路銷售創下新紀錄。
